resolved.Title: sink down
resolved.Description: soar's receiver closes its listener (connection refused) at 30s and comes back at 150s. Events for soar are parked in L1 and redelivered; archive, siem and probe must be unaffected.

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
